boss_battle.name: The Chrono Sovereign
boss_battle.title: Master of Time & Keystrokes
boss_battle.mechanic: The ultimate test: 70+ WPM sustained over multi-sentence literary prose at 98.5%+ accuracy.
battle_texts: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting. Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting. In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take the enemy's country whole and intact; to shatter and destroy it is not so good.

It has long been an axiom of mine that the little things are infinitely the most important. To a great mind, nothing is little. You see, Watson, my methods are based upon the observation of trifles. From a drop of water a logician could infer the possibility of an Atlantic or a Niagara without having seen or heard of one or the other.
